prompt_inputs.goal: Marathon runner preparing for a 20km long training run scheduled for 10:00 AM, requiring carbohydrate-loading and strategic hydration around the workout

solution_criteria: Meal plan covers all three meals plus pre/during/post-workout nutrition timed appropriately around the 10:00 AM training session
Includes adequate carbohydrates (approximately 7-10g per kg body weight) distributed strategically with emphasis on pre-workout fueling
Specifies hydration strategy with fluid intake recommendations before, during, and after the 20km run
All foods align with vegetarian diet and exclude nuts
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a high-endurance athlete (marathon runner) requiring specific carbohydrate-loading and hydration strategies with timing considerations around a long training session
